style: generated_v2: video-based (Grok Imagine I2V) with baked bounce/secondary motion, canonical_ko look
jiggle_note: All clips are tagged baked_motion: the engine must damp chest/pigtail springs and breathing for them (AnimatorConfig::baked_motion_gain in lillith-anim).
notes: Canonical set (committed 2026-10-20). idle = alias of idle_a; idle_a/idle_b are variant_of:idle for random cycling; idle_flirt_* carry idle_variant (pose-cycle mannerisms, not idle loops); finger_wag_tease, hands_behind_head_pose and bounce_giggle are aliases of near-duplicate clips. Batch 13: walk_sassy/skip/saunter_{right,left} (variant_of:walk_right|walk_left), sit_bored_chin/cross_legged_bob/heel_kick/stretch_yawn (variant_of:sit_swing; engine has no walk/sit variant picker yet) and idle_bored_sigh/nail_check/tail_fidget/yawn_stretch (variant_of:idle, idle_variant; ~4 s gesture loops).

animations.generator: Grok Imagine image-to-video (GenerateVideo, 720p, first=last frame = source still) + generated_v2/_tools/build_clip.py
animations.keying: white flood-fill key + enclosed-hole removal (size/purity or isnet-anime matte) + matte trim (_tools/key_white.py)
animations.engine_note: v2 bakes secondary motion into the pixels. Mute or strongly reduce engine chest/pigtail springs and breathing for this clip, or the motion doubles.
animations.matte_note: isnet-anime soft matte + backdrop-plate projection alpha in the edge band (hair/fishnet), minimal-alpha unmix for glow, flow-compensated temporal median of edge alpha (t-2..t+2 video frames), colour decontamination against the backdrop + interior colour fallback, edge lightness clamp (no white halo), premultiplied area downscale, placement registered to the v2 frame, horn_fix as build_clip. Replaces key_white.key_combined.

matte_placement.note: integer canvas offset registered to the v2 frame alpha

seat_align.note: whole clip shifted so frame 0 registers to perch_sit frame 0 (alpha IoU, scale 1.0); seat_y = perch_sit seat_y; seat_x_range = p5/p95 of the opaque run containing x=200 on rows 232/236/240 over all frames; feet_lowest_y = max lowest opaque row
